intervals.label: ECHo-1k phase (medium-scale experiment, about 1 kBq of 163Ho)
intervals.note: Start: the June 2017 overview (open access, published 2017-06-20) calls ECHo-1k the 'present medium scale experiment'; the dates of the data taking are not stated. Evidence that data were acquired: a July 2021 paper analyses 'high statistics data acquired with the first phase of the ECHo experiment, ECHo-1k'. End: the January 2023 ECHo-100k paper says ECHo-1k 'paved the way for the current phase, ECHo-100k'.
intervals.quote: the strategies we have adopted to carry on the present medium scale experiment, ECHo-1K

intervals.label: ECHo-100k phase (aims at a sensitivity below 2 eV)
intervals.note: Start is the arXiv v1 date (2023-01-16) of the paper that calls ECHo-100k 'the current phase'; the true start is earlier and not dated. Open: the most recent source (September 2025, the ECHo-1k result) does not say whether ECHo-100k is taking data on 2026-10-26.
intervals.quote: The results of the first phase of the experiment, ECHo-1k, have paved the way for the current phase, ECHo-100k, which aims at a sensitivity below 2 eV on the effective electron neutrino mass.

name: ECHo metallic magnetic calorimeter arrays with implanted 163Ho

placements.note: Campus-grade point of the Kirchhoff Institute where the detectors are fabricated; the papers do not state where the cryostat that measured the ECHo-1k spectrum stands.
placements.quote: The ECHo-1k detectors have been fabricated on 3'' silicon wafers in the cleanroom facility of the Kirchhoff-Institute for Physics, Heidelberg University.

isotope.quote: The ECHo experiment has been designed for the determination of the effective electron neutrino mass by means of the analysis of the end-point region of the 163 Ho electron capture spectrum.

sensor_count.note: ECHo-1k chip: 72 MMC pixels (36 channels); two such chips were used.
sensor_count.quote: For the first phase of the experiment, ECHo-1k, a 72-pixel MMC array has been developed.

summary.plain: Chips of ultra-cold magnetic thermometers: each pixel holds a few holmium-163 atoms and heats up by a measurable amount whenever one decays.
summary.technical: ECHo-1k: 72-pixel MMC array (gold or silver absorbers, Au:Er/Ag:Er sensors, 163Ho implanted) with SQUID readout; ECHo-100k uses wafer-scale implanted multiplexed arrays.

technology.quote: Metallic magnetic calorimeters enclosing 163 Ho are used for the high energy resolution calorimetric measurement of the 163 Ho spectrum.
technology.value: Metallic magnetic calorimeters (MMC) with 163Ho ion-implanted in the absorber, read out by SQUIDs at millikelvin temperature
